subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue stay open as the combined tracker for Control UI structured reply metadata plus no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split it to the open reply-metadata and final-fallback trackers?
rationale: The remaining work crosses UI request payloads, agent runtime context, channel reply semantics, Codex/runtime context boundaries, and final fallback delivery policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract or tracker shape.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a replacement defines reply metadata and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 settles final fallback delivery semantics.

options.title: Split To Canonical Trackers
options.body: Close this only after maintainers confirm the reply half is fully covered by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 and the no-output half by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Accept Markdown Quote UI As Enough
options.body: Treat the current Control UI quote-text behavior as sufficient for replies, knowingly leaving the original structured metadata ask out of scope.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a replacement defines reply metadata and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 settles final fallback delivery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc merged the current Control UI reply affordance and is the strongest available routing signal for deciding whether that UI behavior is enough or needs a protocol-level follow-up.
